subject: Python Backend Developer (4+ Yrs Exp) — Immediate Joiner
plainText:
Hi [Name],

I'm Milin Chaware, a Python backend developer based in Nagpur with 4+ years of experience in Django REST Framework and FastAPI. I'm currently between roles and available to join immediately, so I wanted to reach out directly in case there's a relevant opening on your team.

• 4+ years building and maintaining REST APIs and backend systems in production
• Most recently at Energy Meteocontrol Solution (Mar 2023–Aug 2026) as a Senior Python Developer

Best regards,
Milin Chaware
